ns2:course.label: Contemporary Directions II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of Dance 541 Contemporary Directions I emphasizing viewing, discussing, analyzing, and writing about the work of current significant contemporary choreographers worldwide with special attention toward contextualizing student research. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: DANC 541 or consent of instructor. Restricted to graduate students only except by permission of instructor.
